hypotheses.L0_manual_trace_is_exact: All manual traces match native logits within 1e-5.
hypotheses.L1_trained_selected_and_unselected_share: In every seed, mixed-model Layer-0 ranks for selected and unselected trained facts differ by at most 15 percent.
hypotheses.L2_compact_rule_coexistence: In every seed, the mixed model's correctly generalized held-out rules have Layer-0 rank at most 80 percent of its unselected training facts.
hypotheses.L3_global_mixed_regime: In every seed, the mixed model's correctly generalized held-out rules have Layer-0 rank within 20 percent of its unselected training facts.
hypotheses.L4_same_prompt_pure_model_is_more_compac: In every seed, the mixed model's held-out-rule Layer-0 rank is at least twice the pure-rule model's rank on the exact same prompts.
hypotheses.L5_late_interfaces_are_compact: All mixed and pure held-out-rule final-layer ranks are at most 25.
hypotheses.L6_mixed_generalization_compresses_with_: In every seed, mixed held-out-rule Layer-0 rank is at least three times final-layer rank.
